description: Find one country's legislation articles by meaning. Hits are today's indexed wording; in_force (omitted when unknown) says whether the provision is in force today, with valid_from / valid_to where indexed. asOf labels each hit for a date and never returns earlier wording: asOfResolved: true (asOfVersion) only when the publisher's dates, as of LexAPI's last recorded read of the act (asOfVersion.checkedAt), show that today's wording already applied then; otherwise asOfReason, and the hit keeps today's text under asOfLabel, not established as the text for the date. asOfVersion.validFrom / validTo are the publisher's dates for today's wording (validTo absent or null: no end recorded). Hits resolve only in countries where LexAPI holds per-provision dates (Austria and Spain at present); others answer asof_not_available. partial: true (SEARCH_INCOMPLETE): this one search did not finish, better matches may exist (see hint); it does not indicate a coverage gap. Each hit's attribution must be kept with republished content (Terms). asOf adds no cost. Cost: 5 credits.

asOf.description: Label each hit for this date (YYYY-MM-DD, 1800-01-01 to today (UTC)). The text stays today's: a wording replaced since that date, or a provision LexAPI no longer holds, cannot be found.

include.description: ["text"] returns full article text instead of a snippet.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter code of a live country, e.g. "at" (lex_national_coverage lists them).

language.description: Not needed. Only the country's own language is accepted (e.g. "de" for AT); any other value is a 400 that names it.

limit.description: Max hits (plan cap, same as lex_semantic_legislation).

query.description: Natural-language description of the provision you are looking for.

name: lex_national_semantic_legislation
title: Semantic search over national legislation
